tldr: An increasingly rare randomized treatment leaves finite private information about its mean even as treated enrollment diverges. A bounded-mean Gaussian experiment simulates every permitted sequentially adaptive private transcript, with an explicit measurable kernel and uniform error. A public stationary release and a private control pilot attain its exact global ATE minimax risk without either oracle mean. The two-report versus three-report transition at \(e^\varepsilon=2\) is also a causal decision transition: above it, even arbitrary history-adaptive binary reports have a strictly larger limiting minimax risk. Certified finite programs evaluate both precision floors. Generic private efficiency and classical bounded-normal decision theory receive full credit.
